ai.overview: UCLA brings the Women's College Basketball Belt to Knoxville for a showdown with Tennessee on November 22, 2026. The Bruins have defended the belt 4 times in their current reign and enter as the clear Elo favorite despite playing on the road. Tennessee, with 17 previous belt reigns, will look to reclaim the championship at home.
key_matchups: UCLA's defensive intensity versus Tennessee's explosive offense that scored 110 against Middle Tennessee and 102 against Radford
Both teams riding 5-game winning streaks into what should be the first major test for either side this season
Tennessee's home court advantage after UCLA dominated their last meeting 99-77 in 2025
ai.betting_angles: UCLA enters with the Elo edge despite Tennessee's perfect 6-0 record versus the Bruins' 4-0 mark. The Bruins have won the last two meetings between these programs, including a decisive 22-point victory in 2025. Tennessee's offensive numbers are eye-popping, but UCLA has been defensively stout, holding four of their last five opponents to 55 points or fewer.
ai.prediction_writeup: UCLA's defensive excellence should keep this competitive even against Tennessee's high-scoring attack. The Bruins held Princeton to just 34 points in their most recent outing and have been consistent on that end all season. While Tennessee brings an undefeated record and home court, UCLA's recent dominance in the head-to-head series (winning the last two by margins of 22 and 12 points) suggests they know how to handle the Volunteers. The Elo model's clear preference for the Bruins combined with their defensive identity should be enough to retain the belt on the road.
